title: Cosmic Eye of the Void
description: A massive surreal eye dominates the center of the composition, its iris glowing with fiery orange and red rings. Inside the pupil floats a small child with a pale face looking directly forward, surrounded by a dark cosmic background. Thick, organic, tentacle-like structures in vivid magenta and purple extend outward from the eye into a swirling nebula of colorful clouds and stars.
prompt: surreal cosmic horror scene featuring an enormous organic eye floating in space, the sclera replaced by swirling purple fleshy tentacles and veins, bright orange fiery iris, deep black pupil containing a small pale child staring forward, dramatic colorful nebula clouds in orange pink and blue filling the background, stars and cosmic dust, highly detailed digital painting with vibrant contrasting colors
